results.title: Agentic AI: 4 reasons why it's the next big thing in AI research
results.content: Agentic AI brings together the versatility and flexibility of [large language models (LLMs)](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/large-language-models) and the precision of traditional programming. [AI agents](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/ai-agents) draw not only from databases and networks, but can also learn from user behavior, improving over time. Agents’ adaptability enables them to handle complex, multistep AI applications that traditional AI would not be able to handle, making them a key part of the modern organization’s [process automation](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/business-process-automation) strategy. These agents might be more [AI models](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/ai-model), or they might be simple search tools that can quickly look up information in a knowledge base or online. Agentic AI gets us closer to the use cases that we, until recently, thought of as science fiction, where machines can complete complex tasks involving complex workflows, [data-driven decision-making](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/data-driven-decision-making) and action-taking with minimal human intervention. Agentic AI can be designed to search the web, called [application programming interfaces (APIs)](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/api) or query databases.
